brief_item.title: OwlPath用结构闭包压缩代码检索上下文
brief_item.direction_name: 上下文定位、构建与裁剪
brief_item.core_conclusion: OwlPath把CodeGraph投影为OWL2知识图，预先物化继承、调用和实现关系，再用3KB模块摘要引导首次查询。18个匹配的SWE-bench Pro实例中，相较仅用CodeGraph，token减少28.8%，墙钟时间减少39.5%。
brief_item.mechanism: SPARQL属性路径一次查询跨多跳关系，闭包物化后由内存缓存服务；摘要先指出模块、核心API和问题相关符号，减少盲目Read、Grep。
brief_item.result: 离线67实例检索中，recall从0.226升至0.464，命中率从59.7%升至88.1%。37题结构检索的recall@all从4.4%升至28.8%，严格应用率为68.4%对66.7%。
brief_item.boundary: 严格应用率提升幅度有限，运行次数也不同。解析、闭包构建和索引更新成本未充分量化，动态代码与未解析符号仍可能缺失。
brief_item.project_relevance: 可按“符号图、结构闭包、首查询摘要”接入代码Agent，分别测索引更新、缓存失效、冷暖查询延迟和工具调用，再判断是否能稳定减少探索。

facts.title: OwlPath: Lossless Knowledge Compression for LLM Bug Repair
facts.event_hint: OWL2 structural retrieval and compact knowledge map for coding-agent bug repair
facts.problem: Coding agents have roughly 100K-token context windows but need structurally related code across million-line repositories. Flat grep, BM25, or embedding retrieval misses multi-hop subclasses, transitive callers, and interface implementations, forcing slow iterative exploration and redundant context reads.
facts.mechanism: OwlPath projects a tree-sitter CodeGraph SQLite graph into an OWL2 ontology, preserving inheritance, calls, implementations, containment, references, and imports. SPARQL property paths retrieve transitive closure in one query; the closure is materialized once and served from an in-memory cache. An OWL Software Knowledge Map adds a 3KB module tree/core-API/issue-symbol summary to guide the first query toward the likely module.

evidence.claim: On matched SWE-bench Pro instances, OwlPath used 28.8% fewer tokens and 39.5% less wall-clock time than CodeGraph-only while achieving a 68.4% strict-apply rate versus 66.7%.
evidence.condition: 18 matched instances; 19 OwlPath runs and 18 baseline runs
evidence.source_locator: PDF pages 1-2, Abstract and evaluation summary

evidence.claim: In offline retrieval over 67 instances, OwlPath improved recall 2.06x from 0.226 to 0.464 and hit rate from 59.7% to 88.1%.
evidence.source_locator: PDF pages 1-2, Abstract and evaluation summary

evidence.claim: On a 37-question structural retrieval benchmark, recall@all increased from 4.4% to 28.8%, with 69–80% performance on transitive-caller and interface tasks.
evidence.condition: Structural retrieval questions involving multi-hop callers and interfaces
evidence.source_locator: PDF pages 1-2, Abstract and evaluation summary

evidence.claim: The OWL-SKM advisory layer compresses a repository/module and issue-symbol map into a 3KB summary that is emitted before the first structural query.
evidence.baseline: Thousands of files in the initial search space
evidence.condition: Module tree, core APIs, issue-relevant symbols

evidence.claim: After one-time O(n+m) closure materialization, transitive structural queries are served as O(1) amortized cache lookups, versus recursive SQL CTE worst-case O(n^k) for k-hop queries.
evidence.baseline: SQL recursive CTE O(n^k) worst case
evidence.condition: n symbols, m edges; SPARQL property paths
evidence.source_locator: PDF page 3, Transitive-closure engine and Complexity analysis

facts.evaluation_context: The paper evaluates an OWL2 reasoning layer over CodeGraph on matched SWE-bench Pro bug-repair instances, a 67-instance offline retrieval set, and a 37-question structural retrieval benchmark. The main comparison controls agent, prompt, tool budget, and leak-proofing; the excerpt does not give repository-size distribution beyond the benchmark counts.
facts.limitations: The strict-apply improvement is small and run counts differ (19 versus 18), so the efficiency gain should not be interpreted as a large correctness gain. Ontology projection, tree-sitter parsing, closure materialization, and index freshness add preprocessing and update costs not fully quantified in the excerpt. The lossless guarantee applies to structural edges represented in CodeGraph; dynamic behavior, generated code, unresolved parsing, or issue semantics outside the graph may still be missed. Results use one agent/prompt setup and may not transfer to arbitrary coding agents (inference).
facts.project_relevance: For Agent semantic acceleration, OwlPath supports a concrete pipeline of symbol graph → structural closure → compact first-query map, reducing exploratory Read/Grep turns and context tokens without dropping multi-hop dependencies. A practical evaluation should separately measure index build/update time, cache invalidation, first-query versus warm-query latency, exact tool calls, and bug-fix success under repositories with changing symbols (inference).
